items.title: The closure of the graph of a rational function in a projective line bundle: properness, the two pullback divisors and the divisor of f
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma packages the standard construction attached to a rational function on an integral X of delta-dimension n: the closure Y of its graph in X times_S P^1_S is proper over X, is an isomorphism over the open set where f is invertible, the two pullbacks of the standard sections are defined, and the divisor of f on Y and on X is the difference of the two cycle classes (statement lines 2700-2731, tag 02RQ). The proof combines four ingredients that are not the lemma itself: properness by composition, definiteness of the pullback divisors via the generic point, a coefficient-by-coefficient comparison of the order of f against the length of the local ring of Y_0, and the identification of the pushforwards of the two cycle classes through assertion (5). The coefficient comparison is the substantive part, so the claim is H2.
